claude_proposed_widenings.name: Attachment.item
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The surface has alter_item_kind, but no activation-phase attachment that can target the staff itself as the altered item.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: you can take a Bonus Action to alter its form, turning it into a 6-inch rod ... or a 10-foot pole, or reverting it a Quarterstaff

claude_proposed_widenings.name: EquipmentPredicate.item_form
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item's passive and reactive riders depend on the staff's current form, and existing predicates can only say holding/wearing/wielding, not which form the item is in.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Acrobatic Assist (Quarterstaff and 10-Foot Pole Forms Only). Attack Deflection (Quarterstaff Form Only). Ranged Weapon (Quarterstaff Form Only).

claude_proposed_widenings.name: emit_light
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The surface has no effect atom for deterministic illumination state with radius and light grade.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: you can cause it to emit green Dim Light out to 10 feet

claude_proposed_widenings.name: return_weapon_to_hand_after_attack
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The surface has no effect atom for automatic weapon return after a ranged attack resolves.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Immediately after you make a ranged attack with the weapon, it flies back to your hand.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: modify_weapon_profile
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The surface can filter by weapon property, but it cannot grant the Thrown property or assign normal/long attack ranges to an item form.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: This weapon has the Thrown property with a normal range of 30 feet and a long range of 120 feet.
